text:
hana-partnerships: Heads-up: co-hosted webinar with NimbusWorks on May 12. We need to finalize speaker swag, run-of-show accessibility bits, and demo failover plan. Who can take what?
amir-marketing: I can coordinate swag. Budget $60 per speaker. Thinking high-quality branded beanie + handwritten note? :beanie:
ruth-events: Can do accessibility + ASL coordination. Also recommend we schedule a rehearsal 30m prior for live captions check.
dave-ops: Demo failover: recommend we have a pre-warmed backup container with a small model in case primary endpoint throttles. Also add a slide with fallback messaging.
hana-partnerships: Nice. We have 3 speakers (2 from Redwood, 2 from Nimbus including lead eng). Shipping: 1 domestic, 1 UK. Shipping deadline Wed COB.
nicole-ux: Beanie might be tricky for formal speakers. Maybe a premium travel mug + eco notebook? lighter, low customs risk. Can mock up insert with co-branded colors.
amir-marketing: Travel mug + notebook works. Choose insulated tumbler (no liquid). Keep total under $60. Will source options by EOD.
ruth-events: ASL: I'll reach out to the interpreter agency and reserve the slot. Captions: using StreamCaption again; need speaker emails for invite. Also will add accessibility note to the registration form.
dave-ops: For the technical runbook: I propose the following snippet for the ops channel: ```
- T-45m: start recording, enable captions
- T-30m: speaker rehearsal + mic check
- T-10m: failover container standby health check
- Live: monitor latency dashboard, switch to fallback if p50>400ms for 60s
```
hana-partnerships: Who writes the thank-you note copy? Amir? Also we should include meeting invite for post-webinar follow-up with Nimbus PR.
amir-marketing: I'll draft copy. Request: include a personal line referencing the demo they presented. Need speaker bios + pronouns for personalization by Tue noon.
nicole-ux: I'll design a 1-sided card with QR to recording + accessibility resources. Will avoid food/snacks for intl.
logistics-bot: Shipping batch created: SHP-9921. Pending label purchase. International customs form required for UK shipment.
dave-ops: Reminder: demo assets (Docker image, model weights pointer) must be uploaded to shared S3 bucket and ACL set to partners-only. I'll create bucket path /nimbus-collab/demo.
ruth-events: Rehearsal scheduling: what timezone works for Nimbus team? They prefer 10am GMT. That means 2am PT for us; can we do 3pm PT previous day instead?
hana-partnerships: Let's offer two slots: Thur 3pm PT and Fri 11am PT. I will ping Nimbus to pick.
amir-marketing: Also, speaker honorarium? Nimbus asked. Budget says small honorarium OK. Recommend $250 per external speaker — approves?
dave-ops: Ops checklist addition: add Slack ephemeral alert to #eng-oncall if failover triggered. Set a runbook link in the alert.
nicole-ux: Copy for accommodation request on invite: "If you need ASL, captions, or other accommodations, email access@redwood.com or reply here." ok?
ruth-events: Good. I'll add a line and set up auto-caption link.
logistics-bot: Label purchased. SHP-9921 tracking: https://ship.example/SHP-9921
hana-partnerships: Action items: Amir - swag + note copy; Nicole - insert + card design; Ruth - ASL + captions + rehearsal; Dave - demo failover container + bucket; Hana - confirm speaker addresses + confirm rehearsal slot. Will follow up Mon morning. Thanks all :sparkles:
